Missing required external dependencies: 'ffmpeg'

To resolve this issue, please install the missing software for your system:

--- macOS Installation ---
Option 1: Using Homebrew (Recommended)
  brew install ffmpeg

Option 2: Manual Download
  • FFmpeg/FFprobe: Download static binaries from https://evermeet.cx/ffmpeg/ or https://ffmpeg.org/download.html
    Extract and copy 'ffmpeg' and 'ffprobe' to /usr/local/bin or /opt/homebrew/bin

After installing the missing dependencies, please restart the application.

Missing required external dependencies: 'ffmpeg'

To resolve this issue, please install the missing software for your system:

--- Windows Installation ---
Option 1: Using Package Manager (winget / chocolatey)
  winget install FFmpeg   (or: choco install ffmpeg)

Option 2: Manual Download
  • FFmpeg: Download build from https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
    Extract zip and add the 'bin' folder to your System PATH.

After installing the missing dependencies, please restart the application.

Missing required external dependencies: 'exiftool'

To resolve this issue, please install the missing software for your system:

--- Windows Installation ---
Option 1: Using Package Manager (winget / chocolatey)
  winget install OliverBetz.ExifTool   (or: choco install exiftool)

Option 2: Manual Download
  • ExifTool: Download Windows executable from https://exiftool.org/
    Rename 'exiftool(-k).exe' to 'exiftool.exe' and add to System PATH (or C:\Windows).

After installing the missing dependencies, please restart the application.

Missing required external dependencies: 'ffmpeg'

To resolve this issue, please install the missing software for your system:

--- Linux Installation ---
Ubuntu / Debian:
  sudo apt update && sudo apt install ffmpeg

Fedora / RHEL:
  sudo dnf install ffmpeg

Arch Linux:
  sudo pacman -S ffmpeg

After installing the missing dependencies, please restart the application.
